summary: Nayax Ltd., an Israeli fintech company, filed a Form 6-K on September 8, 2026, disclosing that director Eran Havshush resigned from the board effective September 1, 2026. The resignation was prompted by a revised Remuneration Policy adopted at a shareholder meeting in May 2026 that prohibited non-executive directors from providing services to the Company beyond their directorship. Havshush, who had served since July 2024, continues as a service provider under a separate agreement. The filing explicitly states the resignation was not due to any disagreement with Company policies. This is a routine director transition, not an abrupt or forced departure, and does not constitute a special-situation event.
